name: command-pages
title: Command pages
description: The ⌘K palette with sub-pages (Move deal to… › Negotiation), and what no command matches handed to an agent.

CommandPagesAnswer.description: The question, then AgentLoading while the answer is on its way and StreamingText once it comes. It scrolls when long, and takes focus (Tab) so the keyboard can scroll it. Other props, `ref` included, go to its scroll box.

props.name: question
props.description: What was asked, over the answer.

props.name: rootTitle
props.description: The first page's name: the breadcrumb's first item. Defaults to the `commands` label.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Adds 'Ask the agent about "…"' as the last row whenever there is a query. Running it (Enter when nothing else matches) calls this with the query and opens the agent's page; each follow-up asked there calls it again.

props.name: answer
props.description: The agent's answer so far. Grow it as it streams; empty it when onAsk is called.

props.name: answering
props.description: More of the answer is coming: AgentLoading until the first words, then the caret.

props.name: controlRef
props.description: Gets the menu's moves, for opening it on a page or an answer from outside.
